name: 251. Custom OpenAI base serves every model once decisions are allowed (decisions opt-in)
description: A custom provider on the OpenAI base whose allowed_requests set decisions to true forwards every model to its upstream's /v1/decisions. Before the fix, OpenAIProvider.Decision checked the model first (a supports_decisions datasheet row, which custom providers never have, or the gpt-6-luna name) and refused anything else with 400 unsupported_operation, so the opt-in was never read and nothing reached the upstream. The profile's openai_decisions_optin provider allows decisions and maps the key alias kserve-decider (canonical name kserve-decider, wire model gpt-6-luna), so the gate sees a name it does not recognize while OpenAI still answers on /v1/decisions. Each case expects 200 with a predicate answer reported under the custom provider: red before the fix (400 unsupported_operation: decisions is not supported by openai_decisions_optin provider), green after. Covered routes: /v1/decisions and the OpenAI SDK route /openai/v1/decisions. The Go SDK enters at the same neutral request and is pinned by TestOpenAIProviderDecisionCustomProviderOptIn.
